title: Majority Fourier Level Relative Error
statement: Let $n$ assign to each positive odd integer $k$ a natural number, and suppose that $n(k)$ is odd and $2k^2\le n(k)$ for every such $k$. For the majority function on the $n(k)$-dimensional sign cube, let $W_k$ be the sum of the squares of its Fourier coefficients over all coordinate subsets of size $k$. As $k$ tends to infinity through the odd integers, $W_k/\bigl((2/\pi)^{3/2}k^{-3/2}\bigr)-1=O(1/k)$.
hypotheses_covered: $n$ maps positive odd integers to natural numbers
$n(k)$ is odd for every positive odd $k$
